episode.showDescription: The official podcast of comedian Joe Rogan.
episode.episodeDescription: Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, is a YouTuber, entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is the founder of Beast Industries and Beast Philanthropy, and the creator and host of the Prime Video competition series “Beast Games.”www.beastgames.comwww.beastphilanthropy.orgwww.youtube.com/@MrBeast Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

transcript_window.text: Yeah, of course.
That movie is great.
Have you seen it?
No, I haven't seen it.
It's really good.
It's really scary and it's very original.
Wait, when did you have the Rack -a -Rack -a Brothers on?
A couple years ago.
Oh, really?
Two years ago?
Yeah, they talk fast as hell.
Dude, they're just trying to corral them.
It's like hey, I don't know what the fuck you're doing.
Super cool guys.
Last time I hung out with them, weirdly enough, they're really into Uno and whatever.
I like competitive games.
And I played a $1 ,000 game of Uno against one of them.
And so we filmed it for a little short for them.
And I lost.
And I was like, okay, well, at least this will be funny.
And then after they leave to go back to our show, they're like, fuck, the SD card's corrupt.
And I was like, oh, what?
So we didn't even get to upload it.
Oh, no.
But it was just funny because it was like we had this like mini set and we were playing like a really intense game of Uno.
We were like slapping cards down.
